prompt: A rangefinder camera with a flat body, one lens and two top dials. A lens barrel projects from the front; the body carries a viewfinder hump. Rounded body shells keep an even thickness around the lens opening. Overall width is 1.20 times depth; height is 0.70 times width. Parts follow functional positions. instruction:
Create a LEGO model of the input. Format your response as a list of bricks: <brick dimensions> <brick position>, where the brick position is (x,y,z).
Allowed brick dimensions are 2x4, 4x2, 2x6, 6x2, 1x2, 2x1, 1x4, 4x1, 1x6, 6x1, 1x8, 8x1, 1x1, 2x2, 1x3, 3x1, 2x3, 3x2, 2x8, 8x2.
All bricks are 1 unit tall.
The world is a 48x48x48 grid. All brick cells must have coordinates from 0 to 47.

### Input:
A rangefinder camera with a flat body, one lens and two top dials. A lens barrel projects from the front; the body carries a viewfinder hump. Rounded body shells keep an even thickness around the lens opening. Overall width is 1.20 times depth; height is 0.70 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous near black, white, dark gray color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
